build_entity_prefab: build an Entity prefab that creates a three-question actor agent with situation and self perception
build_entity_with_goal: build an Entity prefab with a custom goal parameter to guide agent decision making
configure_entity_params: configure Entity params like name, randomize_choices, and history lengths for the agent
build_entity_with_logging: build an EntityAgentWithLogging instance by calling Entity build with a model and memory bank
review_entity_components: review the Entity prefab components including situation perception, self perception, and person by situation
